items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: Tommy, didn't you mention to me once that you remember Bunk Johnson?

ctx.x: That's right. He could play the trombone and he could play the bottle too. That's what killed him. Is that it? That's what killed him. That liquor.
Tommy, didn't you mention to me once that you remember Bunk Johnson? Yeah. Remember Bunk Johnson?
Yeah, I told him I remember Bunk Johnson.
